summary_en: 900,000 shares (2.56% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 10 Aug 2026 at ¥2,050/share (prior close); total outlay ¥1,845M; all acquired shares to be cancelled on 31 Aug 2026. Rationale: capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Share Buyback via Off-Floor Trading (ToSTNeT-3) and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Tokushu Tokai Paper's board authorized a single-day share buyback block to be executed via ToSTNeT-3 on 10 August 2026 at the prior close of ¥2,050/share. The company will acquire up to 900,000 shares (2.56% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, computed as 900,000 ÷ 35,185,012) for an outlay capped at ¥1,845M. The purchase will be a matching transaction against sell orders placed during the designated 08:45 JST trading window on the TSE; execution is not guaranteed if matching volume is insufficient. All shares acquired will be cancelled effective 31 August 2026. The stated rationale is to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns while maintaining operational flexibility in response to future changes in the business environment. The reference date for S/O was 30 June 2026 (35,185,012 shares ex-treasury).
